reading: Andrew Bailey, Governor of the Bank of England, believes regulating artificial intelligence (AI) "is not the right place to start."
Instead, he advocates for "rigorous" testing to find vulnerabilities and establishing safeguards to contain risk.
Writing his first article for Substack, Bailey highlighted that the risks associated with AI are "real and increasingly significant."
He stated that the development of AI should not be prohibited, "on the contrary, the benefits are immense," but emphasized the need for a system of intervention and clear boundaries.
The debate surrounding AI's rapid development and its implications for humanity has recently intensified.
Leaders from major AI firms like Anthropic and OpenAI have called for a slowdown and an internationally co-ordinated approach to assessing risks and implementing safeguards.
OpenAI specifically chose not to release its latest AI model due to safety concerns.
Initially, President Donald Trump rejected the idea of a slowdown, asserting the US lead in the "AI race."
However, after a summit with leading AI firms, Trump announced that executives had signed a "morally binding" document to serve as a "form of protection" from potential AI risks.
This agreement places responsibility for ensuring the safety of their technology squarely on the companies themselves.
In the UK, Bailey noted "important work" underway, including the AI Security Institute, which contributes to forming a set of standards.
While acknowledging progress, he stressed that "the pace of progress must accelerate" but also advised proceeding "with a degree of humility."
Bailey clarified that failures during testing, where "models will behave unexpectedly," are not evidence of testing failure but rather proof of its necessity.
He acknowledged that a more formal regulatory framework might emerge over time, yet maintained that immediate regulation "is not, in my view, the right place to start."

vocabulary.definition: To publicly recommend or support a particular cause or policy.
Forbidden by a rule or law.
Introducing a statement that contradicts something just said; quite the opposite.
The possible results or effects of an action or a decision.
Organized so that all the parts work together effectively.
Evaluating or estimating the nature, ability, or quality of something.
Stating a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
Creating an obligation based on ethical principles rather than legal requirements.
Directly and firmly; without doubt or equivocation.
The quality of having a modest or low view of one's own importance.

entries.ja: 特定の主義や政策を公に推奨したり支持したりすること。
entries.ko: 특정 목적이나 정책을 공개적으로 추천하거나 지지하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 公开地推荐或支持某个特定的事业或政策。
entries.es: Recomendar o apoyar públicamente una causa o política específica.
entries.pt-BR: Recomendar ou apoiar publicamente uma causa ou política específica.
entries.fr: Recommander ou soutenir publiquement une cause ou une politique particulière.
entries.de: Eine bestimmte Sache oder Politik öffentlich empfehlen oder unterstützen.

entries.ja: 規則や法律によって禁じられていること。
entries.es: Prohibido por una norma o ley.
entries.pt-BR: Proibido por uma regra ou lei.
entries.fr: Interdit par une règle ou une loi.
entries.de: Durch eine Regel oder ein Gesetz verboten.

entries.ja: 述べられたことと矛盾する内容を導入する際に用いる表現。まったく反対に。
entries.ko: 방금 언급된 내용과 모순되는 진술을 소개할 때 사용되는 표현. 오히려.
entries.zh-Hans: 引入一个与刚刚说的话相矛盾的陈述；恰恰相反。
entries.es: Se usa para introducir una afirmación que contradice algo que se acaba de decir; todo lo contrario.
entries.pt-BR: Usado para introduzir uma afirmação que contradiz algo que acabou de ser dito; muito pelo contrário.
entries.fr: Introduit une déclaration qui contredit ce qui vient d'être dit ; tout à fait l'inverse.
entries.de: Leitet eine Aussage ein, die dem gerade Gesagten widerspricht; ganz im Gegenteil.

entries.ja: ある行動や決定がもたらす可能性のある結果や影響。
entries.ko: 어떤 행동이나 결정의 가능한 결과나 영향.
entries.zh-Hans: 某个行动或决定可能产生的结果或影响。
entries.es: Los posibles resultados o efectos de una acción o una decisión.
entries.pt-BR: Os possíveis resultados ou efeitos de uma ação ou decisão.
entries.fr: Les résultats ou les effets possibles d'une action ou d'une décision.
entries.de: Die möglichen Ergebnisse oder Auswirkungen einer Handlung oder Entscheidung.

entries.ja: すべての部分が効果的に連携するように組織されていること。
entries.ko: 모든 부분이 효과적으로 함께 작동하도록 조직된.
entries.zh-Hans: 组织起来使所有部分都能有效协同工作。
entries.es: Organizado de manera que todas las partes trabajen juntas de forma eficaz.
entries.pt-BR: Organizado de forma que todas as partes funcionem juntas eficazmente.
entries.fr: Organisé de manière à ce que toutes les parties travaillent ensemble efficacement.
entries.de: So organisiert, dass alle Teile effektiv zusammenarbeiten.

entries.ja: 何かの性質、能力、または品質を評価したり見積もったりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 성격, 능력 또는 품질을 평가하거나 측정하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 评估或估计某事物的性质、能力或质量。
entries.es: Evaluar o estimar la naturaleza, la capacidad o la calidad de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Avaliar ou estimar a natureza, a capacidade ou a qualidade de algo.
entries.fr: Évaluer ou estimer la nature, la capacité ou la qualité de quelque chose.
entries.de: Die Beschaffenheit, Fähigkeit oder Qualität von etwas beurteilen oder einschätzen.

entries.ja: 事実や信念を自信を持って力強く述べること。
entries.ko: 사실이나 신념을 자신감 있고 강력하게 진술하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 自信而有力地陈述一个事实或信念。
entries.es: Declarar un hecho o una creencia con confianza y de forma contundente.
entries.pt-BR: Declarar um fato ou uma crença com confiança e de forma enérgica.
entries.fr: Affirmer un fait ou une croyance avec assurance et force.
entries.de: Eine Tatsache oder Überzeugung selbstbewusst und nachdrücklich zum Ausdruck bringen.

entries.ja: 法的な要件ではなく、倫理的な原則に基づいて義務を生じさせること。
entries.ko: 법적 요구 사항보다는 윤리적 원칙에 기반하여 의무를 부과하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 基于道德原则而非法律要求而产生义务。
entries.es: Crear una obligación basada en principios éticos en lugar de requisitos legales.
entries.pt-BR: Criar uma obrigação baseada em princípios éticos, e não em requisitos legais.
entries.fr: Créer une obligation basée sur des principes éthiques plutôt que sur des exigences légales.
entries.de: Eine Verpflichtung begründen, die auf ethischen Prinzipien und nicht auf rechtlichen Anforderungen basiert.

entries.ja: 直接的に、そしてしっかりと。疑問の余地なく、あいまいさなしに。
entries.zh-Hans: 直接而坚定地；毫无疑问或含糊。
entries.es: De forma directa y firme; sin duda ni ambigüedad.
entries.pt-BR: De forma direta e firme; sem dúvidas ou ambiguidades.
entries.fr: Directement et fermement ; sans aucun doute ni équivoque.
entries.de: Direkt und fest; ohne Zweifel oder Ausflüchte.

entries.ja: 自分自身の重要性について控えめな、または低い見方をする性質。
entries.ko: 자신의 중요성에 대해 겸손하거나 낮게 평가하는 특성.
entries.zh-Hans: 对自己的重要性持有谦虚或低估的看法。
entries.es: La cualidad de tener una visión modesta o poco importante de la propia relevancia.
entries.pt-BR: A qualidade de ter uma visão modesta ou pouco elevada da própria importância.
entries.fr: La qualité de n'avoir qu'une opinion modeste ou basse de sa propre importance.
entries.de: Die Eigenschaft, eine bescheidene oder geringe Ansicht von der eigenen Bedeutung zu haben.
